name: Clip my newest upload
tagline: Every morning: clip the newest video on a YouTube channel
blurb: Finds the channel's newest upload, clips it with App Hub's ClipForge (skipping it if it was clipped already) and hands over the best clips with ready-to-post captions. Make it a routine and tick "Let this routine use your connected tools". Needs App Hub open and its ClipForge connector added.

params.label: How many clips to hand over

task: Use App Hub's ClipForge connector. Make exactly ONE call to its make_clips tool (mcp__clipforge__make_clips, or mcp__apphub__clipforge_make_clips if App Hub is connected as one connector) with input "{channel}", newest true, wait_minutes 9, skip_if_done true, send_to_starnet "agent" and best {count}. Do not call any other App Hub or ClipForge tool and never start the same video twice. Then reply with: the video title and id, and each returned clip best first: hook title, length in seconds, score, its starnet.files path, and its ready-to-post caption. If a file's note says it is too big for Telegram, say so. If the status is not done, give the video id and say it is still working; if it is an error, quote the error exactly.
